phase1_2r_source: R5 formal independent confirmation + R3 frozen UQ calibration

immutable.sentinel_portfolio: NRR: 1 pure-novelty + 2 risk-aware (risk-aware score = 0.5 rank(novelty) + 0.5 rank(auxiliary predicted failure))
immutable.compound_tail: product of the 3 largest operational-profile marginal adverse quantiles

prohibited_on_phase2_data: change number or type count of certainty sentinels
select a new estimator after inspecting external outcomes
use Anti-UAV410 or IDF-DS outcomes to redefine the sampling rule and then report the same data as external confirmation
phase2_order: Phase 2A: Anti-UAV410 task-effectiveness structural external-validation pilot
failure_rule: If the frozen design performs poorly, report the external-validity boundary. Do not retune on the same external dataset and relabel it as validation.
